title: UPI request
summary: An unexpected payment-collection or approval request appears in a payment app.
scenario: The request uses a familiar name or urgent explanation to make you approve money leaving your account.
warning_signs: You are told to approve a request to receive money
The name or amount is unfamiliar
A caller stays on the line while you approve
safe_actions: Do not approve an unfamiliar request
Check the transaction details inside the payment app
Verify the sender outside the incoming conversation
recovery_guidance: Contact the payment provider promptly if you approved by mistake
Secure the account and retain the transaction reference
reporting_guidance: Use an independently checked provider route
prevention_tips: Receiving money should not require sharing a PIN
Review the direction and amount before approval
false_positive_notes: A familiar display name does not prove who controls the account.
